messages:
Anya: Heads-up — exec moved the launch up ~3 weeks. Need to agree on a trimmed MVP by EOD tomorrow. Proposed cutlist below, open to pushback.

Anya: Proposed cuts (first pass):
- remove tenant admin UI (ship skeleton / redirect instead)
- postpone SSO to v1
- defer advanced metrics (keep basic telemetry)
- remove tenant-level custom branding

Matt: Re infra — removing admin UI saves ~2 sprints of frontend + 1 infra task. But we need a small cache + routing change to hit perf targets if we accept more traffic during canary. :thinking_face:

Sarah: UX note — dropping admin UI changes onboarding flows. I can ship a skeleton that redirects to a simple form and surfaces errors. That should be 2 design/dev days.

Jordan: Sales flag — ACME expected SSO in pilot. If we push, risk to their renewal. I'll offer a short-term workaround (SAML cheat-sheet + concierge setup) but need PM endorsement.

Kevin: Engineering suggestion — keep admin behind a feature flag (skeleton enabled only for internal accounts). That gives us the MVP footprint while keeping the code path for v1. Also suggests we can A/B the skeleton vs full.

Anya: Decision matrix so we can finalize quickly:
```
Keep SSO? No (move to v1)
Keep admin UI? Skeleton behind feature flag (opt-in)
Metrics? Basic only
Perf target p95? 200ms
Customer workaround? Concierge SAML if needed
```

Priya: Data callout — current embedding p95 is ~220ms for pilot workload. With a small prefix cache and batching adjustment we estimate ~180ms p95. I'll attach sample numbers to the PRD.

Matt: I'll scope the minimal caching change (estimate: 2 dev-days) and a routing fallback for degraded capacity. Also need one extra dev for pair on the cache work.

Sarah: I'll produce microcopy and the skeleton flows today — will post mocks by 16:00.

Jordan: I'll call ACME and re-set expectations; will offer concierge SAML as temporary. If they push hard, I'll escalate.

Kevin: I can reassign a dev for 48h to pair with Matt.

Anya: Owners: Matt (infra/cache + release canary), Sarah (UX skeleton), Jordan (customer comms). Can we commit to this plan by tomorrow 11:00 so I can update the milestone? :alarm_clock:

Kevin: Yes.

Matt: Yes — will post a short dev plan and blockers in this thread before EOD.

deploy-bot: Reminder: next release window is 2024-05-10 10:00 UTC.

Anya: Great — I'll write a 1-page PRD, update the milestone in the tracker, and add tickets for the skeleton and cache work. Thanks all. :tada:
